name: oracle-flip
description: Writes every tool call to a trace file and refuses to let the agent stop until a hidden oracle reports PASS. The oracle says only PASS or FAIL.

oracle_command.title: Oracle command
oracle_command.description: Command the Stop hook runs to grade the change. Exit 0 is PASS, 1 is FAIL. Leave empty to use the bundled oracle/run.sh.

oracle_store.title: Oracle store
oracle_store.description: Directory of hidden tests, one subdirectory per task id. Read by the bundled oracle. Keep it outside every repository the agent works in.

oracle_image.title: Oracle image
oracle_image.description: Container image for the bundled oracle, pinned by digest, for example repo/oracle@sha256:...

oracle_timeout_seconds.title: Oracle timeout
oracle_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds the Stop hook waits for the oracle before recording an error.
